subject: ACK: Position tracker answered count + all-done flash (spec 20260224-0105)
body:
Implemented both enhancements. Commit: 9e3c4be.

Enhancement 1 (medium): Answered count in tracker
- Tracker shows: 'Q7 of 15 • 6 done' after first correct answer
- 'All done!' when all questions answered
- aria-label: 'Question 7 of 15. 6 questions answered.'
- Tracked via window.answeredQuestions{} (once per question, repeated correct answers don't double-count)

Enhancement 2 (low): All-done flash
- .tracker-all-done: 200ms background flash to var(--color-correct)
- prefers-reduced-motion: animation:none guard in CSS

IntersectionObserver logic unchanged.

Ready for GD QA.
